issues.originalQuote: These roles will remain fixed before observation begins.
issues.revisedQuote: These roles will be maintained until observations begin
issues.problem: “Until” implies that the commitment to fixed outcome roles ends when observation begins, weakening the prespecified outcome hierarchy.

issues.originalQuote: Those questions would need additional measurements and a different follow-up period rather than stronger wording about the same observations.
issues.revisedQuote: Additional measurements and a different follow-up period would be needed to address these questions.
issues.problem: Omits the explicit interpretive limitation that stronger wording about existing observations cannot answer the questions about cellular damage or recovery.
